description: Creates a private dormant copy for the authenticated user. To copy a Marketplace listing, pass its listingId from marketplace_strategies; the publisher must have allowed copying. This copies published code, not a first-build workspace: continue with secure broker/key setup and the normal deployment review, without editing code or starting a backtest unless the user requested that separate work. Pass strategyId to duplicate owned private history; listingId always copies only the explicitly published revision, including for the publisher. External private-link clones also copy only their published revision and non-hidden source files. Credentials, broker bindings, grants, deployments, orders, prompts, runtime setup notes, and trading state are never copied. Paid listings require an active purchase.

aiStrategyId.description: The AiStrategy entity ID for cloning revisions. If not provided, resolved from strategyId.

listingId.description: A Marketplace listing id from marketplace_strategies; copies that listing.

name.description: Optional name for the copy. Defaults to Name (Copy), Name (Copy 2), and so on.

sharePassword.description: Password required by a protected private link, if configured.

shareToken.description: Share token from a private share link. Required for private strategies not owned by you.

strategyId.description: The Strategy entity ID to clone. Required unless listingId is given.

name: clone_strategy
title: Clone/fork a strategy
